units.note: Celsius and millimetres only. Fahrenheit and inches are derived at render time — never duplicate units in this file.

seasonDerivation.rule: Per country and month: base = 2 if the month is in curated bestMonths, 0 if in avoidMonths, otherwise 1. boost = 0.5 for >=1 curated event in that month, +0.5 for >=2 events, +0.5 for >=1 public holiday, capped at 1.0. score = base + boost; season = high when score >= 2, shoulder when score >= 1, otherwise low. A month listed in avoidMonths can never be promoted above shoulder.
seasonDerivation.disclaimer: Curated editorial signal derived from TravelFlow seasonality data, events, and public holidays. It is NOT measured visitor volume and must not be presented as measured data.
